text:
Sam P.: Ok folks — I pushed a first-pass PRD for the Console Insights work (dashboards + tracing + retention). Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/console-insights-prd :wave:
Priya R.: reading now. quick Q: are we targeting per-tenant retention in the MVP or is that deferred?
Marco (UX): I uploaded two quick flows to Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123. One is a simple retention settings modal, the other is a tenant-level rollout flow.
Tess M.: Customer asks (top 3): per-tenant retention, trace-level sampling controls, export to S3/warehouse. They flagged compliance as a blocker for some pilots.
Jordan S.: From infra: we need concrete query-time SLOs and a cap on retention change churn. Otherwise we can get expensive fast. Proposal: enforce soft quota at platform level and surfacing costs in the UI.
Lee C.: Metrics to validate: 1) fraction of queries hitting cache, 2) 95th/99th p50/p95 latency for dashboard queries, 3) monthly cost delta per tenant.
Sam P.: Proposed acceptance criteria (MVP):
```
- Dashboard: show per-model metrics + traces for last 7/30d, default retention 30d
- Retention UI: org-level TTL controls, preview cost impact before apply
- Tracing: up to 30s trace view, sampled by default at 1% with adjustable slider
- Export: ability to trigger S3 export for a date range (manual only)
- Rollout: feature-flagged canary to 5% of orgs, monitoring hooks + automated rollback on error
```
Priya R.: I think per-tenant retention is too big for MVP. Can we make MVP org-level TTL + preview cost calc, and ship per-tenant as v1.1? Customers asked for it but it's a bigger infra lift.
Tess M.: We have two enterprise pilots that explicitly need per-tenant retention for data isolation. If we delay, they'll pause. Can we commit to a canary path for per-tenant but keep it gated behind a paid plan?
Anya (releases): Canary plan is fine if we have clear rollout gates. What are the metrics to unblock? Jordan/Lee, can you propose thresholds?
Jordan S.: Rollout gates proposal:
- Error rate < 0.1% on retention endpoint
- Median dashboard query latency increase < 15%
- Cost delta per org < $X (we'll fill exact number with finance)
If any breached, auto-toggle off via FF.
Lee C.: Add: | of queries using cache > 40% to be considered healthy. Also surface top offenders in the console.
Marco (UX): UX note: show a confirmation step with estimated monthly cost and an impact heatmap. Also add a small in-product tooltip: "Why this costs more".
Sam P.: OK — pragmatic path: MVP = org-level TTL + cost preview + exports + basic traces. Per-tenant retention behind opt-in canary for pilots (v1.0b). We'll commit to v1.1 for broad per-tenant GA.
Priya R.: can we move the export scheduler (auto exports) to v1.1 as well? Manual export is okay for MVP.
Tess M.: Fine if we can promise a timeline and pilot support for enterprise. I'll sync with the pilot customers.
Anya (releases): Who owns the rollout plan doc and FF list? We need owners by tomorrow.
Sam P.: I'll own the rollout doc & acceptance checklist. Jordan will own infra FF and rollback automation. Marco owns UX mocks + copy. Tess will handle pilot comms. Priya will scope backend endpoints for retention APIs. Lee will define telemetry events and dashboards for rollout metrics.
Jordan S.: I'll sketch the FF API and a simple circuit-breaker script. Pushing a draft by EOD.
Lee C.: Adding event names to the PRD now: `console.retention.change`, `console.export.trigger`, `console.trace.sample_rate_change`.
Marco (UX): I'll add the confirmation modal and the tooltip copy to Figma by tomorrow morning.
Sam P.: Next steps: 1) finalize acceptance criteria in the doc, 2) owners deliver artifacts (mocks, FF, telemetry) by EOD Wed, 3) schedule a quick sync Thu to agree on rollout thresholds, 4) decide on pilot list and enable canary.
Tess M.: I'll confirm pilot list by Wed AM.
Priya R.: +1 to timeline. If infra can't support per-tenant by then, we'll lock it to org-level with an explicit note.
Anya (releases): I'll block the Thu release window tentatively for the canary.
Sam P.: Great. I'll update the PRD to reflect MVP vs canary vs v1.1 scope and ping this thread. Thanks all :handshake:
